answer: Identity weight is earned only by finishing a seeded coastal survey. Each epoch plants a knoll beacon, an oasis cistern, and an ocean buoy at derived coordinates. A joiner posts a 25-coin bond for 28 hours and files one tide-staff photo at each mark, at least 7 hours apart. Two watchers older than 18 epochs, with disjoint 40-day trade graphs, stamp every photo. Voting power opens when all six stamps land and the waterlines match a tide table rebuilt from the seed. Peers recompute coordinates and reject reused watcher pairs. Slash a watcher clique that stamps more than two joiners per epoch.
